summary: Mesoblast Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 15, 2026, reporting several Australian Securities Exchange filings made on July 14, 2026. These include a new issue announcement (Appendix 3H), notification of issue of unquoted equity securities (Appendix 3G), an application for quotation of securities (Appendix 2A), and a change of director's interest notice (Appendix 3Y) for CEO Silviu Itescu, disclosing the lapse of 278,571 options. The filing is a routine compliance report of a foreign private issuer under the Exchange Act, covering standard securities issuance notifications and a director's interest update, not a special situation.
